--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -73,8 +73,20 @@
-        stats = {}

+        stats = {}

+        # every pair occurrence, chunk by chunk (in chunk order)
+        all_pairs = list(chain.from_iterable(
+            [zip(chunk_ids, chunk_ids[1:]) for chunk_ids in ids]))
+        # pair occurrences of chunks seen once are counted in C; the others get
+        # stats[p] = stats.get(p, 0) + w one occurrence after the other (the
+        # lazily chained maps finish each update before reading the next pair)
+        _count_elements(stats, chain.from_iterable(
+            [zip(chunk_ids, chunk_ids[1:])
+             for chunk_ids, w in zip(ids, weights) if w == 1]))
+        heavy = [(chunk_ids, w) for chunk_ids, w in zip(ids, weights) if w != 1]
+        if heavy:
+            heavy_pairs = list(chain.from_iterable(

+            heavy_w = chain.from_iterable(
+                [repeat(w, len(chunk_ids) - 1) for chunk_ids, w in heavy])
+            deque(map(stats.__setitem__, heavy_pairs,
+                      map(add, map(stats_get, heavy_pairs, repeat(0)), heavy_w)),
+                  maxlen=0)
